g.text: THRESHOLD: 3+ verified presentations AND 3+ co-author links

text.style: fill: #71717a; font: 8px 'IBM Plex Sans', 'system-ui', 'Arial', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: 12 authors and 27 collaborations, out of 502 authors on the 200 verified presentations. Both rules are applied repeatedly, so every author shown still meets both after\nthe others are removed. Node size and the key number are that author's presentation count; edge width is joint presentations. Position carries no meaning beyond connectivity. Author identity comes from the\nconference database's canonical author IDs, which resolve name variants across all years.
